name: e2e-monorepo
description: An open framework for agentic end-to-end testing

scripts.build: pnpm --filter e2e run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-dev/web run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-dev/mobile run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-dev/github run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-dev/integrations run build
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:dead-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run docs:check-errors && pnpm run check:peer-ranges && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/restore-peer-ranges.ts && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.release: pnpm run build && changeset publish --tag beta
scripts.canary: node scripts/canary-changeset.ts && changeset version --snapshot canary && pnpm run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p scripts
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter e2e run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-dev/web run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-dev/mobile run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-dev/github run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-dev/integrations run test && pnpm run test:scripts
